children: New structure designed to enable direct strategic investment, partnerships, and commercial collaborations
GridFeed built on validated AI technology and commercial engagements with leading renewable energy companies
Platform to be showcased to more than 2,500 energy-market professionals at Energy Trading Week Europe in London
TEL AVIV, Israel, Sept. 09, 2026
-- PRF Technologies Ltd.

(“PRF” or the “Company”) today announced its plan to establish GridFeed™, together with its DeepSolar operations, as a standalone, wholly owned subsidiary, creating a dedicated platform for the continued growth and commercialization of PRF's AI-driven renewable energy technology.

The new structure is intended to enable GridFeed to pursue strategic investment, partnerships and commercial opportunities directly with renewable energy producers, energy traders, utilities, technology companies and sector-focused investors.

GridFeed helps renewable energy operators move beyond producing power to actively managing their financial exposure in increasingly volatile electricity markets. Built on DeepSolar’s AI engine, the platform combines localized weather intelligence, AI-driven production forecasting, battery storage orchestration and market analytics to support day-ahead, intraday and continuous trading decisions, reduce imbalance exposure and maximize the revenue generated by solar, wind and battery storage assets.
The decision follows a period of meaningful technology and product advancement, during which GridFeed advanced toward commercial deployment:

Validated the AI engine powering GridFeed using real-world European utility-scale production, weather, and market data across day-ahead and intraday use cases, while extending the platform into battery energy storage through its Battery-to-Revenue Intelligence capabilities;
Achieved further external recognition of GridFeed’s technology through acceptance into the NVIDIA Connect program; and
Filed PRF’s first patent application related to GridFeed, covering plant-level microclimate forecasting technology designed to improve the accuracy and localization of renewable energy forecasting.

Efraim Cohen-Arazi, Interim Chief Executive Officer of PRF Technologies, commented, “We have built GridFeed into a validated AI platform that addresses one of the most pressing problems in renewable energy: how operators turn production into optimized market revenue. GridFeed’s next phase of growth is expected to be best served by working alongside partners with deep expertise in energy markets, energy trading and renewable asset operation. Establishing GridFeed as a standalone subsidiary is intended to give us a clean vehicle to pursue those strategic options – whether partnerships, strategic investment or other transactions.”

GridFeed will be showcased at Energy Trading Week Europe 2026, September 24–25, 2026 at the Business Design Centre in London, an event expected to attract more than 2,500 energy trading professionals. The Company plans to present to traders, asset owners, operators and balancing responsible parties, join an industry panel and hold meetings with prospective customers and partners.
PRF ended the second quarter of 2026 with approximately $11.6 million in cash and continues to advance its healthcare programs, including the planned U.S. multi-center Phase II trial of OcuRing™-K.
About PRF Technologies
PRF Technologies

is a company focused on the reformulation of established therapeutics, and a developer of AI-driven energy optimization technologies through its DeepSolar platform. The Company’s pharmaceutical programs leverage a proprietary extended-release drug-delivery system intended to provide prolonged post-surgical pain relief while minimizing the need for repeated dosing and reducing reliance on opioids. Through DeepSolar and GridFeed, PRF also delivers advanced software solutions that enable both consumers and enterprises to monitor, forecast, trade and optimize energy – particularly in solar-integrated environments. This dual business model reflects PRF’s strategic commitment to applying precision technology across high-impact sectors including healthcare and sustainable energy. For more information, please visit www.prf-tech.com.
